title: Count Dooku
subtitle: Sith
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: As the charismatic leader of the Confederation of Independent Star Systems and the former Jedi who had apprenticed under Master Yoda himself, no one suspected Count Dooku's true motives. As a secret Sith Lord known as Dark Tyranus, he worked with Darth Sidious -really Sheev Palpatine, Chancellor of the Republic- to play both sides of the war in their grand plan to destroy the Jedi.
